tools.name: flow_upload_file
tools.description: Upload a local image file into the Google Flow project and give it a name, so prompts can reference it as @{name}. Name it by its role (e.g. "avatar", "product", "logo"). If an asset with that name already exists it is reused (no upload) unless replace=true. Typical flow: upload the reference images first, then call flow_generate_image with a prompt that contains @{name}.

filePath.description: Absolute path of the local image to upload

name.description: Asset name to use in prompts as @{name}. Defaults to the file name without extension

replace.description: Upload again even if an asset with this name exists

tools.name: flow_list_assets
tools.description: List the names of the images in the current Google Flow project (uploaded files and generations). Any of them can be referenced in a prompt as @{name}.

tools.name: flow_generate_image
tools.description: Generate images with Google Flow (Nano Banana) in the user's signed-in Chrome and save them to disk; returns the local file paths. Images do not consume Flow credits. To use reference images, upload them first with flow_upload_file and write @{name} in the prompt where the image should be attached: each @{name} becomes a reference chip to that asset (e.g. "Image 1 -> Avatar: @{avatar}"). Any other "@" (like "@Image 1") stays as plain text. Multi-line prompts are kept as written.

prompt.description: What to generate. Use @{name} to reference uploaded assets

model.description: pro = Nano Banana Pro, 2 = Nano Banana 2, lite = Nano Banana 2 Lite

outDir.description: Folder to save into (default D:\PROYECTOS\YOUTUBE AUTOMATION\tools\GoogleFlowMCP\output)

tools.name: flow_new_project
tools.description: Create a fresh Google Flow project and use it from now on. Assets uploaded to the previous project are not available in the new one.

tools.name: flow_generate_video
tools.description: Generate a video from a start frame image using Google Flow (Fotogramas) in the user's signed-in Chrome and save it to disk. The start frame must be an asset already present in the project (use flow_upload_file first). Returns the local MP4 file path.

prompt.description: Video animation prompt describing motion and camera behavior

startFrame.description: Name of the Flow asset to use as Start Frame (e.g. "crystal_orb")

outDir.description: Folder to save into (default D:\PROYECTOS\YOUTUBE AUTOMATION\tools\GoogleFlowMCP\output)

outFile.description: Specific destination file path for the MP4 video

tools.name: refresh_auth
tools.description:
Reload auth tokens from disk or run headless re-authentication.

Call this after running notebooklm-mcp-auth to pick up new tokens,
or to attempt automatic re-authentication if Chrome profile has saved login.

Returns status indicating if tokens were refreshed successfully.

tools.name: notebook_list
tools.description:
List all notebooks.

Args:
    max_results: Maximum number of notebooks to return (default: 100)

tools.name: notebook_create
tools.description:
Create a new notebook.

Args:
    title: Optional title for the notebook

tools.name: notebook_get
tools.description:
Get notebook details with sources.

Args:
    notebook_id: Notebook UUID

tools.name: notebook_describe
tools.description:
Get AI-generated notebook summary with suggested topics.

Args:
    notebook_id: Notebook UUID

Returns: summary (markdown), suggested_topics list

tools.name: source_describe
tools.description:
Get AI-generated source summary with keyword chips.

Args:
    source_id: Source UUID

Returns: summary (markdown with **bold** keywords), keywords list

tools.name: source_get_content
tools.description:
Get raw text content of a source (no AI processing).

Returns the original indexed text from PDFs, web pages, pasted text,
or YouTube transcripts. Much faster than notebook_query for content export.

Args:
    source_id: Source UUID

Returns: content (str), title (str), source_type (str), char_count (int)

tools.name: notebook_add_url
tools.description:
Add URL (website or YouTube) as source.

Args:
    notebook_id: Notebook UUID
    url: URL to add

tools.name: notebook_add_text
tools.description:
Add pasted text as source.

Args:
    notebook_id: Notebook UUID
    text: Text content to add
    title: Optional title

tools.name: notebook_add_drive
tools.description:
Add Google Drive document as source.

Args:
    notebook_id: Notebook UUID
    document_id: Drive document ID (from URL)
    title: Display title
    doc_type: doc|slides|sheets|pdf

tools.name: notebook_query
tools.description:
Ask AI about EXISTING sources already in notebook. NOT for finding new sources.

Use research_start instead for: deep research, web search, find new sources, Drive search.

Args:
    notebook_id: Notebook UUID
    query: Question to ask
    source_ids: Source IDs to query (default: all)
    conversation_id: For follow-up questions
    timeout: Request timeout in seconds (default: from env NOTEBOOKLM_QUERY_TIMEOUT or 120.0)

tools.name: notebook_delete
tools.description:
Delete notebook permanently. IRREVERSIBLE. Requires confirm=True.

Args:
    notebook_id: Notebook UUID
    confirm: Must be True after user approval

tools.name: notebook_rename
tools.description:
Rename a notebook.

Args:
    notebook_id: Notebook UUID
    new_title: New title

tools.name: chat_configure
tools.description:
Configure notebook chat settings.

Args:
    notebook_id: Notebook UUID
    goal: default|learning_guide|custom
    custom_prompt: Required when goal=custom (max 10000 chars)
    response_length: default|longer|shorter

tools.name: source_list_drive
tools.description:
List sources with types and Drive freshness status.

Use before source_sync_drive to identify stale sources.

Args:
    notebook_id: Notebook UUID

tools.name: source_sync_drive
tools.description:
Sync Drive sources with latest content. Requires confirm=True.

Call source_list_drive first to identify stale sources.

Args:
    source_ids: Source UUIDs to sync
    confirm: Must be True after user approval

tools.name: source_delete
tools.description:
Delete source permanently. IRREVERSIBLE. Requires confirm=True.

Args:
    source_id: Source UUID to delete
    confirm: Must be True after user approval

tools.name: research_start
tools.description:
Deep research / fast research: Search web or Google Drive to FIND NEW sources.

Use this for: "deep research on X", "find sources about Y", "search web for Z", "search Drive".
Workflow: research_start -> poll research_status -> research_import.

Args:
    query: What to search for (e.g. "quantum computing advances")
    source: web|drive (where to search)
    mode: fast (~30s, ~10 sources) | deep (~5min, ~40 sources, web only)
    notebook_id: Existing notebook (creates new if not provided)
    title: Title for new notebook

tools.name: research_status
tools.description:
Poll research progress. Blocks until complete or timeout.

Args:
    notebook_id: Notebook UUID
    poll_interval: Seconds between polls (default: 30)
    max_wait: Max seconds to wait (default: 300, 0=single poll)
    compact: If True (default), truncate report and limit sources shown to save tokens.
            Use compact=False to get full details.
    task_id: Optional Task ID to poll for a specific research task.

tools.name: research_import
tools.description:
Import discovered sources into notebook.

Call after research_status shows status="completed".

Args:
    notebook_id: Notebook UUID
    task_id: Research task ID
    source_indices: Source indices to import (default: all)

tools.name: save_auth_tokens
tools.description:
Save NotebookLM cookies (FALLBACK method - try notebooklm-mcp-auth first!).

IMPORTANT FOR AI ASSISTANTS:
- First, run `notebooklm-mcp-auth` via Bash/terminal (automated, preferred)
- Only use this tool if the automated CLI fails

Args:
    cookies: Cookie header from Chrome DevTools (only needed if CLI fails)
    csrf_token: Deprecated - auto-extracted
    session_id: Deprecated - auto-extracted
    request_body: Optional - contains CSRF if extracting manually
    request_url: Optional - contains session ID if extracting manually
